## Eleven-virtue checklist
### Product virtues
- [ ] **Working**: behavior is correct and validated.
- [ ] **Unique**: no duplicate logic; SPOT preserved.
- [ ] **Simple**: local complexity reduced or bounded.
- [ ] **Clear**: intent is obvious and names are readable.
- [ ] **Easy**: design supports safe future changes.
- [ ] **Developed**: domain concepts used over primitive manipulation.
- [ ] **Brief**: unnecessary code/noise removed.

### Stewardship virtues
- [ ] **Aligned**: follows existing architecture and conventions.
- [ ] **Discovered**: change made from understanding of existing code.
- [ ] **Traceable**: rationale is clear (requirement, defect, or domain reason).
- [ ] **Conservative**: smallest safe change was chosen.

## Naming checklist
- [ ] Names match team/domain vocabulary already in use.
- [ ] Names describe purpose and intention.
- [ ] Context is used to avoid redundant prefixes/suffixes.
- [ ] Name length matches scope/lifespan.
- [ ] Noise words are removed unless they add distinction.
